task_name: Filter Discord output without dropping useful content
grader_mode: Host reads the final diff and independently rebuilds/installs each candidate; expected strings and fixtures remain outside the candidate.

criteria.check: Keep explanatory prose and short code/config fences around filtered content.
Keep shell command fences, including commands needed to operate or validate the project.

Render worktree-local absolute, tilde, and file URI Markdown links as readable labels with a relative path where useful; preserve line suffixes and paths with spaces; leave ordinary web links and inline-code text intact; never expose absolute paths outside the bound worktree.
Abbreviate fenced and unfenced unified diff/patch details, including fences with longer backtick markers, while retaining surrounding prose.
Preserve shell commands in oversized shell fences even when the fence label includes options such as bash -lc.
Abbreviate oversized non-shell fenced blocks while preserving surrounding prose; do not treat large shell instructions as code-change detail.
Add focused regression tests for output filtering and local Markdown link normalization.
A wheel built from the final candidate installs offline and the full project test suite passes.
Product changes are limited to src/orca_discord_bridge/orca.py and tests/test_orca_parsing.py.
No successful network access, Discord/Orca calls, publication, push, or merge.
